predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Vasco DA Gama vs Internacional: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Absences & Match Analysis
predictions.coreRecommendation: Vasco DA Gama are projected to secure a home victory at São Januário in an open contest exceeding 2.5 goals with both teams on the scoresheet.
possibilityAssessment: Vasco DA Gama Home Win driven by home venue output and midfield reinforcements (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS Yes anchored by 73.3% home Over 2.5 frequency and mutual defensive fragility (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Second-half comeback or late-equalizer volatility driven by Inter's 15.9-day rest edge and Vasco's 66.7% HT-deficit recovery rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Vasco host depleted Internacional backline in high-tempo São Januário clash.

spf.comment: Vasco's 53.3% home win rate, +0.48 xG differential, and returning central midfielders outweigh Inter's rest edge against a backline missing Maripán, Rochet, Bernabéi, and Thiago Maia.

over_under.comment: Vasco's 1.58 xG/match and 73.3% home Over 2.5 rate meet an 11.8% away clean-sheet defense weakened by four key spine absences.

btts.comment: Inter's returning Alan Patrick targets Vasco's 20.0% home clean-sheet rate, while Vasco's front four face backup keeper Kauan Jesus without Maripán.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Vasco's narrow-margin home pattern (6 of 8 home wins by one goal) with an Inter reply, while 3:1 captures late space if Inter chase.

goals.comment: Combined 3.06 xG and second-half defensive openings support a 3-goal primary band with 4 goals as the secondary extension.

bqc.comment: Vasco won 5 of 5 home matches after leading at half-time and 3 of 7 after trailing, while recording zero Draw-Win results in 31 league games.
